_about: Self-test set for the Legixo Q&A API. 15 cases: 10 single-source, 1 multi-source, 4 out-of-corpus. Facts transcribed from the fiction corpus in corpus/. Run with: python -m scripts.run_eval
_matching: expected_contains items are matched after normalisation (lowercase, markdown/currency/comma stripping, whitespace collapse). A string item must appear; a list item is satisfied if ANY variant appears.

cases.question: What is the notice period in the Bluecrest employment agreement?
How long is the non-compete at Bluecrest and what limits it?
When is the next hearing in Arvind Mehta v. Northfield Logistics and who will be examined?
cases.notes: Date + person from the same memo.

cases.question: What is the limitation period for contract claims under the Riverside Code?
cases.notes: Fact sits in the memo, not the statute file - checks retrieval doesn't just pattern-match 'Riverside'.

cases.question: How many days before a hearing must written arguments be filed?
cases.notes: Number written as a word in the source.

cases.question: What happened in Lakeview Society v. City Water Board?
cases.notes: Second case in the listing - must not be confused with CV-2024-8812.

cases.question: When is mediation mandatory before trial, and how long must it last?
cases.notes: Statute Section 14. Question asks for BOTH the threshold and the duration - the original wording ('when is mediation mandatory') only asked the condition, so omitting the 30 days was a fair answer and the assertion was unfair.

cases.question: What interest rate applies to delayed payments when the contract fixes no rate?
cases.notes: Statute Section 22. Model often writes '9 %' - normalisation handles it.

cases.question: What did Northfield offer in settlement and what was the client's counter instruction?
cases.notes: Two numbers, both required - checks the answer isn't half-complete.

cases.question: What is the security deposit for Unit 4B and when is it refundable?
cases.notes: Currency symbol and Indian digit grouping stripped by normalisation.

cases.question: What time is case CV-2024-8812 listed, and what is the settlement posture in that matter?
cases.notes: MULTI-SOURCE: must cite both the hearing notice and the counsel notes.

cases.question: What is the arbitration seat in the Bluecrest agreement?
cases.notes: OUT-OF-CORPUS: real document, but arbitration is never mentioned.

cases.question: What is the monthly rent for Unit 5C?
cases.notes: OUT-OF-CORPUS: corpus only covers Unit 4B. Tests entity precision, not topic matching.

cases.question: What is Priya Nambiar's salary?
cases.notes: OUT-OF-CORPUS: real person in the corpus, fact never stated.

cases.question: What is the notice period at Harbor Bean Roasters?
cases.notes: OUT-OF-CORPUS TRAP: splices the notice-period concept (file 02, Bluecrest) onto the tenant in file 06. Retrieval returns confident-looking chunks from both; only a real grounding check refuses it.
